summary:
We developed "Bangladesh Earth System Trend Detective web app".
The web app will address the challenges by:
- Making Earth observation data easier to explore and understand.
- Helping users identify environmental trends and unusual changes.
- Presenting complex scientific information through interactive visualizations.
It is important for
-Supporting researchers in exploring changes across Earth's interconnected systems.
- Increasing public awareness of climate change and environmental challenges.
-Finally our solution will help to bridge the gap between complex scientific data and meaningful environmental understanding.
details:
It works in the following way-

1. Select different districts of Bangladesh.

2. Select an environmental variable:

- Land Surface Temperature (LST)

- Rainfall / Precipitation

- Vegetation / NDVI

- Terrestrial Water Storage (TWS)

3. Select a temporal period, preferably 2003–2025, depending on dataset availability.

4. Retrieve authentic NASA satellite and model data.

5. Process and aggregate the data at district level.

6. Calculate statistically valid environmental trends using:

- Mann-Kendall trend test

- Modified Mann-Kendall test where serial autocorrelation is significant

- Theil-Sen slope estimator

- Sen's intercept

- Kendall's tau

- Z-statistic

- P-value

- Confidence intervals

7. Display interactive maps, charts, statistical summaries, and scientific interpretations.

Benifits of the project-

The main benefits of this project are improving environmental awareness, supporting climate change research, identifying vulnerable regions, and helping communities and decision-makers make informed decisions.

Intended impacts-

Ultimately," Bangladesh Earth System Trend Detective" will help to transform environmental data into meaningful insights and encourage students, researchers, policymakers, and the general public to better understand, investigate, and protect Bangladesh's environment.

Tools, coding languages, hardware, or software were use to develop the project-

Chatgpt,Antigravity,Hatchable,Capcut,VEED,CSS

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xE005kN2ZJmaQmJDMnwEdV25tnTcjmqT/view?usp=drive_link

The creative aspect of this project is its detective-style approach to environmental research. Instead of simply presenting climate data, it investigates environmental changes like a detective, searching for hidden patterns, unusual events, relationships, and long-term trends in Bangladesh's Earth systems.

The project considers NASA data,data accuracy,statistical significancy, accessibility, regional differences, climate risks, and user-friendly presentation.
